cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Stay for the Result
cards.instruction: Keep them present until the contest, bargain, or consequence reaches an undeniable outcome.

mechanism: Copy a diner's confident folding as bill handling, then refuse departure until the payment outcome is read aloud.
confusable: Not simple cost interrogation: B2 must expose a napkin mistaken for the bill, and A3 must cover before pursuing the actual receipt.
comparison: A settled bill still needs shared acknowledgment; the alternative awaits an unmeasured contest result.
seedUse: Retains dinner bill, starter and keeping B present; introduces napkin confusion and a payment receipt as new facts.
